proof_body:
by
  intro α _ s
  refine ⟨s.toJordanDecomposition.posPart, s.toJordanDecomposition.negPart, s.toJordanDecomposition.posPart_finite, s.toJordanDecomposition.negPart_finite, s.toJordanDecomposition.mutuallySingular, fun A hA => ?_⟩
  have h := s.toSignedMeasure_toJordanDecomposition
  calc s A = s.toJordanDecomposition.toSignedMeasure A := by rw [h]
    _ = (s.toJordanDecomposition.posPart A).toReal - (s.toJordanDecomposition.negPart A).toReal := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.JordanDecomposition.toSignedMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.toSignedMeasure_sub_apply hA]
      rfl
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] (s : MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure α), ∃ μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α, MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ ∧ MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν ∧ μ.MutuallySingular ν ∧ ∀ A, MeasurableSet A → s A = (μ A).toReal - (ν A).toReal
